newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU grain intvn stocks rise to 1.93 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: EU grain intvn stocks rise to 1.93 mln tonnes.

text.p: European Union intervention grain stocks rose to 1.93 million tonnes net as of June 26, from 1.83 million on June 16, European Commission figures showed.
Stocks totalled 2.60 million tonnes at the start of the season on July 1, 1996.
Soft wheat stocks totalled 324,686 tonnes against 346,598, and barley 616,616 tonnes against 550,238 previously.
Another 382,161 tonnes of grain, which had been offered before the intervention season closed on May 31, was still being considered to see if it met quality standards.
